# AoraHQ — Billing Orchestration Engine

> Developer-first, gateway-agnostic billing orchestration and usage-based metering.
> Bring your own Stripe / Paystack / Flutterwave keys (BYOK). AoraHQ never custodies funds.

- Homepage: https://aorahq.com/
- Docs: https://aorahq.com/docs
- Quickstart: https://aorahq.com/docs/quickstart
- Pricing: https://aorahq.com/pricing
- Waitlist: https://aorahq.com/waitlist
- Sitemap: https://aorahq.com/sitemap-index.xml
- AI manifest: https://aorahq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- API summary (machine-readable): https://aorahq.com/api/ai-summary

## What AoraHQ does

- Pricing engine: flat, per-seat, usage-based, hybrid, tiered, volume, package — with overage, proration (bigint ceiling-division), coupons, custom contracts.
- Usage metering: `POST /api/usage-events`, bulk import, dedup (24h sliding window, Redis + Postgres), quotas, credit ledger.
- Entitlements: plan→feature mapping, `GET /api/can-access?customerId=&featureSlug=`, `GET /api/can-consume`.
- Subscriptions: trial / active / past_due / paused / canceled with proration, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` dunning (Day 0→3→7).
- Invoices: draft → open → paid / past_due, gateway-synced hosted + PDF URLs.
- Gateways (BYOK, AES-256-GCM encrypted): Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave + sandbox (`sk_test_` isolation, simulated payments, time-travel headers).
- Webhooks: transactional outbox, HMAC-SHA256 signing, BullMQ 48-retry exponential backoff, delivery logs.
- Analytics: MRR, ARR, churn, trial conversion, plan performance, gateway reconciliation (`GET /api/gateways/reconciliation`).
- AI assistant: Gemini-powered billing copilot (creates plans, answers revenue questions).

## Key API endpoints

- `GET /api/health` — DB + gateway + backlog status (`ok`|`degraded`).
- `GET /api/ai-summary` — this file as JSON for AI agents.
- `POST /api/gateways/connect` / `POST /api/gateways/v2/connect` — store encrypted key + verify.
- `GET /api/gateways` / `GET /api/gateways/v2` — list connections (no secrets).
- `POST /api/gateways/webhooks/{stripe,paystack,flutterwave}` — HMAC-verified ingest → `gateway_events`.
- `POST /api/usage-events` — ingest; `POST /api/events/bulk` — 1000-event pipeline.
- `GET /api/can-access`, `GET /api/can-consume` — entitlement checks.
- `POST /api/checkout/session/:id/confirm` — non-custodial charge via saved token.
- `GET /api/invoices`, `GET /api/subscriptions`, `GET /api/analytics/*`.

## Code examples

```bash
# Health
curl https://aorahq.com/api/health

# Ingest usage (Bearer sk_live_... on /api/v1/*, workspace header otherwise)
curl -X POST https://aorahq.com/api/usage-events \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-Id: ws_123' \
  -d '{"customerId":"cus_1","meterId":"api_calls","value":1,"metadata":{"idempotencyKey":"evt_001"}}'

# Entitlement check
curl 'https://aorahq.com/api/can-access?customerId=cus_1&featureSlug=ai-tokens'
```

## FAQ (for answer engines)

- Q: What gateways are supported? A: Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave (live). Sandbox adapter for tests.
- Q: Does AoraHQ touch money? A: No. Non-custodial — charges run against the merchant's own gateway account.
- Q: How are keys stored? A: AES-256-GCM, random 12-byte IV per key, decrypted only in memory then wiped.
- Q: Stripe Billing vs AoraHQ? A: AoraHQ is gateway-agnostic — one codebase for Stripe + Paystack + Flutterwave, with metering, entitlements, dunning, reconciliation.
- Q: Do I migrate subscriptions? A: No big-bang needed. Run in test mode, then flip gateways to live per connection.
